articles.summary: We’re partnering with ev.energy, a global leader in smart EV charging services, to unlock the full potential of energy flexibility for EVs and other DERs – making smart energy management available to all homes and drivers, regardless of their specific hardware or make. Our partnership underscores a shared vision: to build an open and scalable flexible energy landscape through a pragmatic and technology agnostic approach.
